mapper.sql: id, code, name, sort, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys_post WHERE deleted = 0
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
SELECT id, code, name, sort, status FROM sys_post WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_post (code, name, sort, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{sort}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 1), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{version}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_post SET deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_post up JOIN sys_user u ON up.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE up.post_id = #{postId}
